setting.label: Maximum trailer resolution
setting.help: Auto = the addon detects the TV's native resolution and limits the maximum trailer resolution accordingly (up to 4K on a 4K TV, up to 1080p on a Full HD TV). Video quality then automatically adapts to the available internet speed. 720p / 1080p / 2160p = a fixed maximum resolution, regardless of the display (useful on low-performance devices with a 4K panel).
